title: NeuralWarsFilmShotV2
description: Shot object for The Neural Wars FILM. Requires character_ids[] + location_id from WORLD_TOKENS.json; lock_sheet_id + reference_images for continuity. Legacy `characters` (display names) and `location` (free prose) remain allowed but must not contradict token ids.

characters.description: Legacy display names (e.g. Kora Vega). Must align with character_ids[]; do not contradict.

location.description: Legacy free-prose location label. Must align with location_id; do not contradict WORLD_TOKENS lock.

action.description: Editorial/action beat; NOT sent verbatim to image models if it contains cue words

status.description: e.g. draft, pending, rendered, failed, failed_video

lock_sheet_id.description: Primary lock sheet id (e.g. LOCK_SHEET_KORA_VEGA). Required by CANON when a locked principal is in frame.

reference_images.description: Paths to locks/refs/<character_id>/ stills or approved continuity stills.

cues.description: Non-rendered screenplay cues (e.g. hand signal beat). Never copy into image_prompt/video_prompt.

character_ids.description: Stable ids from WORLD_TOKENS.characters (e.g. mileo_chen, kora_vega). Required.

character_id.description: Optional singular lead id; prefer character_ids[]. Must match WORLD_TOKENS.characters key.

location_id.description: Stable id from WORLD_TOKENS.locations (e.g. tunnel_six, fracturados_redoubt). Required.
